jobs.title: Business Development Associate
jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world’s best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

Business Development Associate

As a Business Development Associate, you will play a key role in driving Astranis’ global growth strategy. You will help identify, engage, and develop relationships with prospective customers across enterprise, government, and telecommunications markets worldwide. Sitting at the intersection of sales, marketing, finance, and solutions engineering, you’ll support high-priority commercial pursuits and build the top of Astranis’ future pipeline.
This is a high-impact role with visibility across the commercial organization, ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and is motivated to make an impact.

Associate programs at Astranis typically last for a minimum of twelve weeks.

Role

- Identify and research high-potential prospective customers, partners, and markets to build Astranis’ commercial pipeline across new and existing geographies.

- Develop targeted outbound prospecting campaigns: including account research, personalized outreach, and follow-up—to create qualified sales opportunities.

- Support inbound commercial inquiries by conducting initial research, qualifying opportunities, and coordinating next steps with the appropriate internal teams.

- Conduct in-depth market and customer research to uncover connectivity needs, industry trends, competitive dynamics, and potential use cases for Astranis’ satellite internet and private-network solutions.

- Partner closely with Commercial, Solutions Engineering, and Finance teams to develop customer-specific materials, support discovery and diligence, and advance active opportunities through the sales process.

- Help prepare for and execute customer meetings, industry events, conferences, and executive engagements; translate conversations and leads into clear follow-up actions and pipeline opportunities.

- Maintain accurate prospect and opportunity information, track outreach performance, and surface insights that improve targeting, messaging, and pipeline development.

- Support strategic go-to-market initiatives, including account prioritization and analysis, market-entry planning, and competitive positioning.

Requirements

- 1+ years of experience in business development, sales, consulting, market research, or a commercial role; experience in satellite communications, telecommunications, aerospace, or adjacent industries is a plus.

- Demonstrated interest in outbound prospecting, customer engagement, and building relationships with senior external stakeholders.

- Strong research, writing, presentation, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex technical and commercial concepts into compelling customer narratives.

- Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple prospective opportunities and priorities in a fast-moving environment.

- Strong business judgment and curiosity, with an interest in understanding customers, markets, and the commercial drivers behind buying decisions.

- Comfortable working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams.

- Experience with CRM tools, Excel, and presentation software is a plus.

- Ability to work independently in a dynamic, fast-growing environment.

The base salary for this position is $1,750 per week.

Base Salary
$1,750 — $1,750 USD

U.S. Citizenship, Lawful Permanent Residency, or Refugee/Asylee Status Required

(To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States, or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3))

This position will be responsible for shaping and developing U.S. government (USG) civil space business opportunities. - Preparation of written materials (talking papers and briefings.

- Materials to support the shaping of requirements that align Astranis capabilities with civil space mission priorities

- Responses to requests for information

- Proposal leadership activities such as capture manager, proposal manager, or volume lead

- Assess competitor capabilities and offerings to understand the competitiveness of our offerings across USG and commercial markets

- Identify opportunities for industry partnerships to expand Astranis systems capabilities, product offerings, and access to civil space pursuits

- B.S. or B.A. in engineering or hard science

- At least 5 years of experience in engineering, program management, corporate strategy, or USG sales/business development

- Working knowledge of US civil space community, commercial space industry, associated organizations and on-going programs

- Willingness and ability to travel as needed, up to 40% of time

- Strong motivation to form product offerings to expand USG market share

- Excellent written and oral communication skills

- US Citizen or Green Card Holder

- At least 7 years of experience in engineering, program management, corporate strategy, or USG sales/business development

- Working knowledge of satellites, space science and weather systems / architectures and missions

- Federal-level capture/proposal management and/or government acquisition experience

- Travel: Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (~15-20% of the time).

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or a related discipline (or comparable experience).

Trade and Regulatory Compliance Manager

We are seeking a results-driven Trade & Regulatory Compliance Manager to join our legal department and oversee our trade, ethics, and regulatory compliance programs. This role is anchored in U.S. export controls (ITAR and EAR), but also expands into broader corporate regulatory management. You will partner closely with engineering, supply chain, HR, and commercial sales teams to build scalable compliance frameworks that mitigate legal risk while driving operational growth.

Role

- Lead the strategy, daily administration, and continuous enhancement of the company’s trade and regulatory compliance program

- Serve as the subject matter expert across key regulatory domains, including ITAR, EAR, OFAC sanctions, Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA), and FAR/DFARS provisions

- Classify complex technical data, hardware, software, and defense services against the Commerce Control List (CCL) and United States Munitions List (USML)

- Evaluate emerging business initiatives and foreign engagements to determine regulatory requirements; prepare and manage export authorizations, licenses, or agreements as operational needs arise

- Draft, submit, and administer filings through government portals (including DECCS and SNAP-R) as necessary

- Partner across engineering, supply chain, HR, and commercial sales teams to manage foreign national access, establish Technology Control Plans (TCPs), and review vendor/partner agreements

- Support regulatory compliance aspects of U.S. Government business, including ethics program alignment, mandatory disclosures, and foreign ownership/influence considerations

- Lead internal compliance reviews and risk audits; draft voluntary self-disclosures or regulatory filings as required

- Develop and deliver company-wide training on export controls, anti-bribery, trade compliance, and corporate ethics

- Track changes in federal laws and trade policies to update internal standards and operational procedures accordingly

Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in business, international relations, legal studies, logistics, engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

- 4+ years of hands-on regulatory compliance experience, with core expertise in U.S. export controls (ITAR/EAR)

- Working knowledge of OFAC sanctions, FCPA anti-corruption standards, and USG contracting compliance rules (FAR/DFARS)

- Familiarity with U.S. government filing systems, such as DECCS and SNAP-R

- Strong ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into clear, actionable guidance for technical and business partners

- Excellent written and oral communication skills with meticulous attention to detail and a high sense of urgency

- Ability to prioritize, manage multiple compliance projects, and solve problems independently in a fast-paced environment

Bonus

- J.D.

- Certified U.S. Export Compliance Officer (CUSECO) or other recognized trade compliance certification

- Prior experience in the aerospace, defense, satellite, or advanced hardware manufacturing industries

- Knowledge of U.S. Government (USG) contracting compliance, FAR/DFARS requirements, or CFIUS regulations
